sourceContext: Human priority override: finish Implementar v3 completely before any other application phase. Dashboard Analytics is explicitly PAUSED_BY_USER/PARKED and must receive no new turns. Closeout is local-only until explicit publication approval.
objective: Finish all currently owned Implementar v3 work locally, certify the actual current V3 state, reconcile canonical V3 documentation and roadmap to facts, prepare a publication-ready local branch, then stop at LOCAL_COMPLETE / HUMAN_PUBLICATION_APPROVAL_REQUIRED before any application push, PR, merge, deploy or production action.
why: N5.3 is CLOSED/PASS, but Implementar v3 is not yet fully closed because the current V3 visual state is not certified against the current implementation lineage and canonical V3 documentation contains stale or branch-specific certification statements. The user requires V3 closeout before N5.4 or Dashboard Analytics.
factualRemoteBaseline: Remote implementacion-v2 candidate branch is codex/post-v3-n52-document-extraction at 35c64394c3c37aa5b2efdb82b7bff8c0b40eaf36.
35c64394c3c37aa5b2efdb82b7bff8c0b40eaf36 is documentation-only N5.3 evidence; certified implementation code SHA is a009240adb798860cdbda95dbd3a3704adc8ccc3.
N5.3 runtime and final independent review are CLOSED/PASS; QA residue is zero and production mutations for that certification were zero.
The branch is diverged from main: remote compare observed ahead 66, behind 303, merge base a42bad7c650d98d5366472c59bea0bf6e71c2123.
No pull request is currently published for codex/post-v3-n52-document-extraction.
Issue 22 is the canonical Implementar v3 / implementacion-v2 tracker.
Last durable binding evidence on Issue 22 identifies thread 01a0c321-3dbb-7610-b09a-d897a7afecb0 as Implementar v3; runtime must prove whether it is still the valid current thread.
Issue 24 Dashboard Analytics is PAUSED_BY_USER/PARKED. Its existing command/task/run/thread/worktree/branch, if any, must remain untouched and receive no new turns.

Canonical V3 docs are inconsistent: V3_UX_REFINEMENT_ROADMAP reports GLOBAL_FINAL_CERTIFICATION READY while V3_VISUAL_INTEGRITY_CERTIFICATION still contains blocked historical branch evidence. Closeout must reconcile documents to current facts without duplicating them.

Last certified implementation gates include focused N5.3 tests 39/39 PASS, prior full suite 662/662 PASS on the same product bytes, lint PASS, tsc-via-build PASS, build PASS and diff check PASS. These must be rerun locally for final closeout.
scope: FIRST perform a factual local audit before any edit: current branch, HEAD, git status, unpublished commits, uncommitted changes, worktree path, current ORCHESTOR task/run, current Codex thread binding, current phase, completed objectives, pending objectives, current tests/lint/typecheck/build, issues/PRs/docs and human gates.
Preserve all valid local work. Never reset, clean, stash away, overwrite, rebase or discard unknown local changes.
If valid uncommitted Implementar v3 changes exist, inspect them, preserve them and create a safe LOCAL checkpoint commit when appropriate. No application push.
Reuse workstream implementacion-v2 and the existing Implementar v3 Codex thread if it is provably valid. Do not create a new thread when the existing thread is valid.

If the last-known thread is invalid, prove invalidity and locate exactly one valid existing Implementar v3 thread before creating any replacement. A replacement is allowed only when no valid current thread exists and must preserve the same task/workstream identity.

Hard-park Dashboard Analytics before dispatch: no new Dashboard Analytics turns, no branch/worktree/run/thread mutation, no merges, no cleanup, no reuse. Preserve it for a later human-authorized round.
Determine the exact current Implementar v3 phase from repository facts. Do not open N5.4, N5.5, Dashboard Analytics or unrelated features.

Close all remaining in-scope Implementar v3 findings only. Current known closeout focus includes current-lineage visual certification, visual lineage/delta reconciliation where necessary to prove the intended V3 state, regressions found by that certification, canonical documentation reconciliation and local release readiness.

Use the deterministic authenticated Playwright V3 release matrix already present when applicable. Do not attribute historical fc287507 visual PASS to current code without fresh current-lineage evidence.
Repair actionable in-scope technical failures autonomously: audit -> plan -> implement -> test -> review -> repair -> retest -> rereview -> recertify until no reparable P0/P1/P2 findings remain.
Historical failures outside scope may remain only when baseline provenance is demonstrated unambiguously and documented.

Update existing canonical documents instead of creating duplicates. At minimum inspect APP_TRANSFORMATION_ROADMAP.md, V3_UX_REFINEMENT_ROADMAP.md, V3_VISUAL_INTEGRITY_CERTIFICATION.md, V3_GLOBAL_FINAL_CERTIFICATION_CLEAN_RC.md, POST_V3_GLOBAL_RELEASE_CERTIFICATION.md and relevant release-readiness records.

Create one concise final closeout document only if no existing canonical document can truthfully hold final architecture, implemented scope, tests, decisions, debt/limitations, pending publication gate and next phase.
Update roadmap/status/acceptance/QA/release-readiness documents to actual facts. Do not rewrite historical evidence as if it were current.
Prepare the branch locally for publication with known clean diff, local commits, final review evidence and exact publication impact.
Inspect read-only repository/Vercel integration evidence needed to state whether merging/pushing main would trigger production. Do not deploy or mutate remote settings.
At completion publish only ORCHESTOR control-plane result/tracker evidence; do not publish application source.
outOfScope: Dashboard Analytics implementation, tests, docs, dependency changes or new Codex turns.
N5.4, N5.5 or any new post-V3 product phase.
New product features not already part of Implementar v3 acceptance or a repair required to close an existing V3 finding.
Application git push, PR creation/update, merge, release or deployment.
Supabase remote mutation, migration, Edge deploy, Storage mutation or Auth mutation.
Vercel deploy or remote project setting mutation.
Secrets, credentials, DNS, billing, payments or real external communications.
acceptanceCriteria: Factual local baseline is persisted before edits, including branch, HEAD, dirty/clean, local-only commits, unpublished changes, task/run/thread/worktree and exact current phase.
Valid pre-existing local work is preserved; no user work is lost or overwritten.
Exactly one active Implementar v3 task lane is used under projectId=costa-clean-app and workstreamId=implementacion-v2.
Existing valid Implementar v3 thread is reused; no duplicate thread is created.
Dashboard Analytics is PAUSED_BY_USER/PARKED and receives zero new turns; its state remains byte/state untouched.
All currently owned Implementar v3 objectives are either completed or explicitly proven historical/out-of-scope debt; no reparable in-scope finding remains.
Current-lineage V3 visual certification is PASS against the final local product HEAD, including authenticated responsive coverage and network/environment isolation.
Focused tests PASS.
Full tests PASS, or any failures are proven pre-existing baseline failures with exact evidence and no Implementar v3 regression.
Lint PASS.
Typecheck PASS.
Build PASS.
git diff --check PASS.
Security/integrity gates PASS.
Final independent review has no relevant P0/P1/P2 findings.
Canonical V3 documentation and roadmap are updated to current facts without duplicate status documents.
Local branch/worktree state is known and publication-ready, preferably CLEAN after local checkpoint/final commits.
Publication impact is documented, including whether merge/push to main would trigger Vercel Production.
Final state is LOCAL_COMPLETE / HUMAN_PUBLICATION_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
Application remote mutations remain zero.
requiredApprovals: Any pull request creation or update.
Any merge to main or another shared application branch.
Any Vercel deployment or Production action.
Any Supabase remote or database mutation.
Any secret, credential, DNS, billing, payment or external communication.
Any material scope expansion beyond closing existing Implementar v3 work.
stopConditions: No unique safe Implementar v3 task/thread ownership can be established after bounded factual audit.
Valid local user changes exist but cannot be safely preserved without destructive or ambiguous action.
A required fix belongs to Dashboard Analytics or a new product phase rather than Implementar v3 closeout.
Completion requires a forbidden remote/production/sensitive action.
Bounded no-progress guards are exhausted with unresolved P0/P1/P2 correctness or security findings.
A final clean local state cannot be achieved without deleting or overwriting unrelated user work.
verificationRequirements: Report LOCAL_BRANCH, LOCAL_HEAD_BEFORE, LOCAL_HEAD_FINAL, WORKTREE_PATH and WORKTREE_CLEAN_FINAL.
Report LOCAL_UNCOMMITTED_FOUND, LOCAL_ONLY_COMMITS_FOUND and how each was preserved.
Report THREAD_ID_BEFORE, THREAD_ID_FINAL, THREAD_REUSED and THREAD_VALIDATION_EVIDENCE.
Report exact completed objectives and exact remaining debt/limitations.
Report focused tests, full tests, lint, typecheck, build, diff check and security/integrity results.
If baseline failures exist, report exact failing tests plus baseline commit evidence proving no regression.
Report authenticated visual matrix and environment/network isolation evidence against final local HEAD.
Report independent review severity counts P0/P1/P2/P3 and repairs performed.
Report canonical docs updated and any single closeout doc created.
Report local commits created during closeout and final diff summary.
Report REMOTE_APPLICATION_PUSH=0, PR_MUTATIONS=0, MERGES=0, DEPLOYS=0, SUPABASE_REMOTE_MUTATIONS=0, PRODUCTION_MUTATIONS=0.
Report whether merge/push to main is expected to trigger production and the evidence for that statement.
Final output must be IMPLEMENTAR_V3_LOCAL_COMPLETE=YES or a genuine HUMAN_REQUIRED safety gate with exact reason.
